svg.title: Status: libraries* 0.0%, hardware 9.3%

rect.title: CDVD: extracted disc files — Disc extracted with its .disc_layout (27 files, single layer); menus load from it
DualShock 2 controller — Classic libpad: scePad* stubbed, and scePadRead fills the pad DMA buffer the game reads
R3000A CPU (IRX in the interpreter or compiled to C++) — The 9 disc IRX modules run in the interpreter
SPU2: audio output — libsd imports go to the native sound engine: menu music and announcer play; crackle; SNDF effects silent
Memory card — Classic libmc stubbed to the runtime; the empty card is seen, saving untested
SIF: EE ↔ IOP RPC and DMA
R5900 CPU (recompiled to C++) — 13,630 functions recompiled; boots to the main menu and the character select
DMA controller — Native DMA service with the scratchpad (SPR) address bit; no controller model
INTC: VSync and GS interrupt — The runtime's VBlank is fixed at NTSC 59.94 Hz; this game is PAL (50 Hz)
Timers — Native EE clock: the recompiler turns timer reads into clock calls
GS: primitives and framebuffer — Native OpenGL renderer; menus clean (Z clamp, flip after queued work, field blend)
GS: textures, CLUT and fonts — Menu textures and text correct

svg.text: * Functions of the static Sony libraries linked into the game ELF (config/funcmap.csv). Hardware: weighted per component.
